question: In a certain code language, 'HABIT’ is written as 'ITAHB' and 'BASED' is written as 'EDABS'. How will 'GAMES' be written in that language
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Letters are repositioned within the word.

 
• First letter → Shifted to the fourth position within the word.
 
• Second letter → Shifted to the third position within the word.
 
• Third letter → Shifted to the fifth position within the word.
 
• Fourth letter → Shifted to the first position within the word.
 
• **Fifth letter **→ Shifted to the second position within the word.

​​So,

 
• 'HABIT’ is written as 'ITAHB'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f48aeaea5ab72440034069199ad9cffbcf4c12b273109514199b816ee4ac3ed.png] 

​And,

 
• 'BASED' is written as 'EDABS'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3540d58d03f79f9bf066e31578597990e29bc105843f28f3520dd07aed3203b9.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'GAMES' is written as :

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b82c0287a2c0ea5465a52baee19fb3d3baeb666f799334b99d62ecf5179d3057.png] 

Hence, "**ESAGM**" is the correct answer.
